job.job_description:
Greetings from TCS!!!

TCS presents an excellent opportunity for AI Developer with AWS

Role: AI Developer with AWS

Experience range: 8-10 Years

Location: Chennai, Kochi, Kolkata, Coimbatore




Job Summary-

We are seeking an experienced AI Developer with AWS to design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications using Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and cloud technologies. The candidate should have strong expertise in Python, Prompt Engineering, RAG frameworks, API development, and AI model integration.




Key Responsibilities-

Develop and deploy Generative AI applications.
Build LLM-based solutions using OpenAI/Azure OpenAI.
Design and optimize prompts for AI models.
Develop REST APIs using FastAPI.
Implement RAG and LangChain-based solutions.
Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems and databases.
Monitor and improve model performance, accuracy, and scalability.
Follow AI governance and security best practices.



Mandatory Skills-

Python
Generative AI (GenAI)
Large Language Models (GPT, Llama, Claude)
Prompt Engineering
LangChain
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
FastAPI / REST APIs
Machine Learning
SQL
OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
Vector Databases
Git & CI/CD
